description: This header file defines an abstract class 'GatekeeperStorage' within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. The class provides an interface for secure data storage operations such as Allocate, HasKey, Read, and Write, tailored for sensitive storage needs in the context of Android's Gatekeeper component. It includes methods to handle binary blobs, with read/write functionality utilizing JSON keys and TPM buffers.

classes.name: GatekeeperStorage
classes.description: An abstract class that defines methods for secure, traceable binary data storage related to the Gatekeeper component.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates storage for a given key with specified size.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in storage.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data associated with a key, returning a TPM2B_MAX_NV_BUFFER.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data associated with a key into storage.
